$comment: SITE-5 · фразы English, которые должен вычитать носитель или менеджер в Дубае (Р-7, вычитывающего пока нет). Каждая запись — needsReview: файл словаря en, путь к строке, текст строки как есть, что смущает. tests/content.test.ts сверяет, что строка по пути существует и текст не изменился: поправили фразу — уберите или обновите запись. Снимки — поле shot вместо path.

items.note: Main headline: check that it reads naturally for UAE F&B owners.
The scene shows supplier debts; "Unpaid invoices" may be clearer.
Meaning is "too many disconnected services"; consider "Apps that don't talk to each other".
Closing line of the scene: check rhythm and punctuation.

items.text: Run the guest journey from first inquiry to the next visit
items.note: Spelling: the site follows the product UI in US spelling (program, inquiry). UAE readers often expect UK spelling (programme, enquiry); if changed, change site and product together.
The product UI calls this section "Staff" (top menu), the registry uses "People Overview". Pick one name for site and product.

items.text: Revenue, food cost, gross profit, guests, average check and discounts, against the previous period.
items.note: "Average check" matches the product UI; UAE/UK usage is often "average spend".

items.text: Six loss channels, from deletions after pre-check to refunds, plus discounts and write-offs, broken down by staff member.
items.note: Terms "pre-check" and "comps" come from the product UI; check they are clear to a UAE operations manager.

items.text: Guest count was in line with a typical Friday, but spend per guest was lower, so revenue came in below normal.
items.note: Illustrative answer without figures (the real answer was not recorded on staging). Check tone.

items.text: Amounts on screen are rounded to the nearest dirham.
items.note: Check wording; alternative: "Amounts are rounded to whole dirhams."

items.text: Standard onboarding is included with annual billing: one supported connection, user access set-up and a kick-off session for your team. Anything else is quoted separately.
items.note: "One supported connection" may be unclear (one POS or data-source integration).

items.text: Monthly, or annually in advance with {annualDiscount} off the subscription and standard onboarding included. Prices exclude VAT; VAT at {taxRate} is added on top.
items.note: VAT wording for the UAE; {taxRate} is filled from prices.json.
Demo knowledge base shows "Rough coffee recipe" (machine translation of "raf"). Demo content, not site copy: fix in the demo data (DEMO-20) or replace the screenshot.
